title: Innokin Coolfire P60 Replacement Pods 2ml
description: The Innokin Coolfire P60 Replacement Pods are designed for use with the Coolfire P60 Pod Vape Kit, offering reliable performance and easy refilling in a compact 2ml format. Each pod features an integrated PZP Max mesh coil for enhanced flavour and smooth vapour production. These pods are available in three resistance options to suit a wide range of vaping styles: • The 0.8ohm pod is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with a tighter draw and lower power output (12–14W). Best used with 50/50 , Bar Salts or Nic Salts E-Liquid • The 0.6ohm pod provides a balanced restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) experience at 18–23W. Best used with 50/50, Bar Salts or Nic Salts E-Liquid • The 0.4ohm pod is perfect for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping, supporting higher power levels of 40–60W. Best used with High VG (sub-ohm) E-Liquid Each pod includes a convenient top-fill mechanism and leak-resistant design, making them easy to refill and maintain. These are fixed-coil pods—once the coil reaches the end of its lifespan, simply replace the entire pod. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
